description: Diagnostic that sharpens I013 for the current tip; it makes no recipe change. Run the E010 recipe exactly as committed (Muon, Lookahead/EMA, 24→28→32 px, 9 epochs, last group 512) offline on held-out seeds 3-12 through the same harness code path. Record per-seed accuracy, the 10-seed mean, the std and the offset from the seeds 0-2 mean (0.7548). In the same pass, record per-epoch CUDA-event times to settle H3.3.1. Do not edit submissions/arena/.
